item.title: Seeing Machines wins robotics development deal beyond automotive
item.summary: When Seeing Machines issued a trading statement this week announcing surging revenues, we said that the company was one to keep an eye on. This view was validated this morning when the technology company revealed it had set its sights on an entirely new application for its AI-powered driver-monitoring technology.
